Name: Nokia Gesture touch
Description: Nokia gesture touch navigation (often Android-based) replaces traditional buttons with swipes: swipe up to go home or open apps, and swipe from the edge to go back. Key motions include double-tap to wake, flipping to mute, and lifting to check the phone. Users can customize these in Settings > System > Gestures.
